A curious mind.

Joshua Ly ↗

I like the moment when a messy problem starts to make sense.

My work brings together business analysis, product thinking, AI systems, and hands-on building. Sometimes the result is a working tool. Sometimes it is a prototype, a process, or an architecture worth exploring.

Jeff Electric gives that work a real operational setting. Projects like BuildBrief, the backlog planner, and Business Discovery AI let me keep testing how better questions become better systems.
